_about: Visitor-facing names. Segment keys are trait poles as in profiler/ocean.py LABELS. 'label' is what the profiler shows now; 'alt' are replacements Baby can choose; 'audience' is the one-line ad-platform description the dossier may show under the label. Changed after review: Lurker, Pleaser and Exposed Nerve moved to alternatives because they can read as insults; Neuroticism is shown as REACTIVITY. The profiler's ocean.py LABELS should follow this file.

E+.label: The Performer
E+.audience: responds to an audience. dwell rises when watched.

E-.label: The Observer
E-.audience: watches more than it acts. long dwell, low input.

O+.label: The Seeker
O+.audience: rewards novelty. high response to change.

O-.label: The Literalist
O-.audience: prefers the familiar. low response to change.

C-.label: The Drifter
C-.audience: skips steps. high exit risk, high return.

A+.label: The Opt-In
A+.audience: complies with prompts. high completion rate.

A-.label: The Contrarian
A-.audience: rejects the default. responds to dares.

N+.label: The Live Wire
N+.audience: responds to reassurance. retention rises under comfort.
